delivery_units.title: Canonical instructions, calls and CFG
delivery_units.acceptance: Migrate a bounded straight-line emission path to MethodAnalysis first, then branches; retain the existing path until parity is demonstrated. Validate operand boundaries, wide calls, exceptional edges, source offsets and hot-path performance.

delivery_units.title: SSA variables and typed emission
delivery_units.acceptance: Make typed SSA values govern expression construction and Java locals. Validate branch/loop phis, register reuse, handler pre-write state, null/boolean/int ambiguity, arrays and wide words; compile and execute representative output.

delivery_units.title: Constructor and instruction normalization
delivery_units.acceptance: Validate aliasing, this/super delegation, uninitialized values, argument captures and allocation/exception timing; integrate in typed expression emission.

delivery_units.title: Effect-aware expressions and shrinking
delivery_units.acceptance: Validate move/constant substitution, arrays, boxing and simplification with ordered side-effect traces, throwing operands and numeric edge cases. Exercise both shrink positions.

delivery_units.title: Exception, finally and monitor regions
delivery_units.acceptance: Normalize nested/shared handlers and cleanup ownership; verify cleanup exactly once on normal/exceptional exits, rethrows, nested monitors and checked exceptions.

delivery_units.title: General region construction and verification
delivery_units.acceptance: Use shared region IR for if/switch/loops and an independent edge verifier. Test multiple latches, backward/shared exits, fall-through, string hash collisions, enum dispatch and nested labeled exits.

delivery_units.title: Class-level transformations
delivery_units.acceptance: Validate anonymous/captured classes, enum state, field initialization, synthetic members and method inlining with cross-method usage invalidation, class initialization order and object identity checks.

delivery_units.title: Generics, overrides, names and access
delivery_units.acceptance: Parse generic signatures and resolve hierarchy families; compile overload, bridge, shadowing, varargs and access fixtures; preserve original symbol/navigation identity.

delivery_units.title: Debug, Kotlin and naming metadata
delivery_units.acceptance: Validate DEX debug programs and metadata, apply scopes/names only to surviving values, and test Kotlin supported-pattern boundaries and comment/span preservation.

delivery_units.title: Constants and resource transformations
delivery_units.acceptance: Validate framework/app constant identity, ambiguities, non-final R fields and switch legality; retain original numeric meaning and resource navigation.

delivery_units.title: Code generation and recovery gate
delivery_units.acceptance: Require legal typed regions and stable spans before source publication. Verify per-method recovery, cancellation, deterministic output, Java compilation and navigation after every presentation rewrite.

delivery_units.title: Optional deobfuscation and mapping parity
delivery_units.acceptance: Implement and test configurable name inference, source-file names and mapping round-trips without altering original DEX identities. Optional behavior remains open until tested or explicitly excluded.
